sourceTitle: Quick Sweet Potato Black Bean Burritos
sourceText:
Quick Sweet Potato Black Bean Burritos
By: Melissa Peterman
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 12:37am

Ingredients




16 ounces bag of frozen sweet potatoes
1 can black beans
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
1 pinch pepper
Tabasco, to taste
2 cups shredded cheddar cheese
4 tortillas

Preparation

1 Microwave frozen sweet potatoes in a glass dish until soft and heated through.  Add one can of black beans into a dish and mix with salt, garlic powder, pepper and Tabasco. 2 Divide sweet potatoes, beans and cheese among 4 tortillas. Microwave each for 1 minute or until heated through.

About


Quick and easy, great recipe for college!
